name: ghostpaw-questlog
description: Local tasks, calendar commitments, and recurring work.
long_description: Local tasks, calendar commitments, and recurring work. Stores data in a local SQLite database.

db_path.title: Database path
db_path.description: Path to the local SQLite database.

tools.name: manage_hooks
tools.description: List or remove outbound webhook targets, run a tick, or inspect pending and failed deliveries.

tools.name: search_questlog
tools.description: Search quests and rumors by text when you need to find an existing item before inspecting or changing it.

tools.name: review_questlog
tools.description: Review one operational questlog surface such as available quests, open rumors, blocked work, or due repeatable anchors.

tools.name: inspect_questlog_item
tools.description: Inspect one specific questlog item in depth and return its richer structured detail and important related refs.

tools.name: capture_rumor
tools.description: Capture uncertain incoming work as a rumor so it can be triaged later without prematurely turning it into committed execution.

tools.name: shape_work
tools.description: Create a quest (with timing, tags, and objective in one call), create a questline, settle a rumor into concrete work, or manage quest-questline membership. Use create_quest for clear commitments — include tags and timing directly to avoid follow-up calls.

tools.name: plan_quest
tools.description: Refine a quest by revising its objective before actual start or by changing its temporal planning fields.

tools.name: run_quest
tools.description: Run quest lifecycle actions such as starting, logging effort, finishing, abandoning, or abandoning and spawning follow-up quests atomically.

tools.name: organize_work
tools.description: Organize grouping and dependency structure by updating questlines or changing hard unlock prerequisites between concrete quests.

tools.name: manage_repeatable
tools.description: Manage recurring work definitions by creating, updating, previewing, spawning, or archiving repeatable quests.

tools.name: tag_work
tools.description: Classify work by adding, removing, or replacing tags on quests and by replacing the future tag template set on repeatable quests.

tools.name: reward_work
tools.description: Manage rewards by adding, updating, removing, or claiming quest rewards, or by replacing future reward templates on repeatable quests.

tools.name: retire_work
tools.description: Hide an item from normal active operation without rewriting history by soft-deleting a rumor, quest, questline, or repeatable quest.
